part1.intro: The examiner asks you about yourself, your home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Maps
questions: Do you think it's better to use a paper map or a map on your phone? [Why?]
When was the last time you needed to use a map? [Why/Why not?]
If you visit a new city, do you always use a map to find your way around? [Why/Why not?]
In general, do you find it easy to read maps? [Why/Why not?]

part2.topic: Describe an occasion when you had to do something in a hurry.
points: why you had to do this in a hurry
part2.closing: and explain how you felt about having to do this in a hurry.

topics.title: Arriving late
questions: Do you think it's OK to arrive late when meeting a friend?
What should happen to people who arrive late for work?
Can you suggest how people can make sure they don't arrive late?

topics.title: Managing study time
questions: Is it better to study for long periods or in shorter blocks of time?
What are the likely effects of students not managing their study time well?
How important is it for students to have enough leisure time?
